title: Shiraishi An — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's give An our birthday wishes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But also, I can't believe you're here! I had no idea you were coming to watch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, looks like we managed to pull off our surprise!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I brought a cake and some snacks. Please dig in, everyone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shizuku!
That's so thoughtful of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, this is the least I can do on your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ideally, we would've liked to go to a cafe or restaurant.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With this many people, that would have been impossible without a reservation. Sorry about that, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't even worry about it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, celebrating out here in the park feels really spacious and relaxing!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, I kinda get what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, it's a shame Li'l Bro and Toya couldn't stay for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah. They said they both had plans later, so they had to get going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Specifically, they needed to go help set up the party in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? What a shame.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I just remembered!
This is your birthday present from me♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks!
I wonder what it is... Can I open it now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course!
You're gonna love what I got you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, ear cuffs! They're so cute. I love them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They have little sparkling stars on them. I bet they'll look really good on you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right?!
They're a new item for this season that we just got in at work!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I also thought they'd look good on you, so I got you a pair. Am I or am I not a fashion genius?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You are! I'm gonna put these on now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We have a present for you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's a hamper of beauty products! There's lotion, hair oil, all sorts!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow! Thanks, you guys!
Are these products that you all use?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yep! I recommend this body oil. It smells amazing and absorbs quickly, so you can use it without any hassle!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I use this hair oil. It leaves your hair shiny and soft, so you should try it out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow! With idol endorsements like that, I bet these are all gonna work like magic!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, you can count on that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I bet! I'm gonna start using these today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to have such a big birthday celebration.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Speaking of which, who planned the surprise? Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wrong answer! Guess again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Then... Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I do love a good surprise, but not this time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not you either? Then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
C'mooon!
The obvious person is sitting right by you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...? Wait, you mean...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This was your idea, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. I thought it would be nice for everyone to get together for your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you were so excited for the street performance, so I wanted everyone else to come watch.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't really do anything... I just invited everyone. But I'm glad you've had a good time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not nothing!
You're the best partner I could ask for, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! An, I can't breathe!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Mizuki & Haruka
rows.Line:
Hahaha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our surprise went off without a hitch! The look on your face was priceless!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You must have really been getting into the song since you didn't spot us watching right up close.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? I wish I could've heard them perform.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, it was an amazing performance. I heard that the big event they were working on was a success, and it's no surprise with voices like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow. I'll have to go see them perform sometime. Shiraishi, keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, An♪
I had so much fun chatting until it got dark at your surprise party!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Shiraishi didn't even want to go home then, did she? We must've talked for three hours already, and she hadn't had enough.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's heartwarming for guests to hear from the birthday girl that she wants to spend more time together. I'm glad you had a good time, An.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's all get together again sometime, and you can get your fill of chatter. Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to make up for missing the surprise party with a grand birthday celebration!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, we'll be sure to outdo ourselves. I'll come up with an exciting new show to mark the occasion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I'd like to sing you something to make up for missing the party.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you look forward to it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
It seems you thoroughly enjoyed your surprise party.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You were still energetic by the time of the party in SEKAI... Well, as long as you had a good birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. It made me happy to see you smiling so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's keep giving it our all, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys! Thank you so much for all your birthday wishes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got to tick something off my list, had a surprise party thrown for me and overall had the best birthday I could ask for!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The latest in a long list of things I owe to the amazing people around me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel like this I've been energized to be an even better singer! Just watch this space!
